patch_list: Stops the between-games Unity LevelPlay/IronSource interstitial from being loaded or shown. The app's own `mm_noads_new` purchase sets `Settings.playWithJokerOld` to suppress it, so this also gives that paid behaviour to builds without the…

Skips the rewarded Unity LevelPlay video that gates the Public Zone matchmaker and reports it as watched immediately, so the room search starts at once. The app's `mm_noads_new` purchase does not cover this ad.
